Write a Python function that parses the bracketed application format [ts] [LEVEL] [module] message into a dict
output:
import re

PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"^\[(?P<ts>[^\]]+)\] \[(?P<level>[A-Z]+)\] \[(?P<module>[^\]]+)\] (?P<message>.+)$")

def parse_bracketed(line):
    m = PATTERN.match(line.strip())
    if not m:
        return None
    d = m.groupdict()
    d["level"] = d["level"].lower()
    return d
